carryover.title: 目录页与书签目标有一页偏移
carryover.evidence: Current check reports 17 of 392 entries where bookmark_page - printed_contents_page = -1.
carryover.impact: The PDF bookmark lands on the facing page rather than the printed contents page for affected entries; the content itself remains in order.
carryover.recommendation: Keep the documented convention or align the PDF bookmark anchors with printed contents, then update the checker expectation with a concrete page-level fixture.
carryover.acceptance: All 392 entries match the declared page convention and the fixture fails if a bookmark is moved to the wrong page.

carryover.title: 附录 F 内部链接目标页与 aux 记录页不一致
carryover.evidence: Current check reports 31 of 35 links whose PDF target page differs from the corresponding aux page; examples include sec:ch2-debye (target 31, aux 34) and sec:ch2-criteria (target 34, aux 37).
carryover.impact: Readers following the source-map links can land several pages away from the section recorded by the build metadata.
carryover.recommendation: Trace how appendix F constructs those links and compare the actual destination against the named section in the current PDF; correct anchors or the audit's interpretation only after a rendered-page spot check.
carryover.acceptance: Each of the 35 links resolves to its named section heading, and the check distinguishes intentional anchor offsets from wrong destinations.
